svg.text: Armored cash-transport · the unlockable — contestant vehicle dossier
“There is no wish I want granted. I came to close the Ledger.”
Jet black, no markings — erased from the record
Heavier on the inside than the outside, somehow

markings, windows blacked out from outside, a
heavy reinforced front ram, sinister and
